title: Pharma Intelligence OS — Pharmacovigilance & Regulatory Intelligence Workspace
description: Browser-based pharmacovigilance workspace: ICSR case review with human verification, ICH E2B(R3) package generation, disproportionality signal management (PRR/ROR), PSUR/PBRER working drafts, official-source status monitoring, and FDA approval tracking from the public openFDA feed. E2B transmission to EMA EudraVigilance and official regulatory submissions are registration-gated by design; the workspace never fabricates a regulatory status.
